notes.title: New Winter Tower Abilties!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42766782/65459a0cc408ca8ac75eeb719d3fbe1a9548335d.png[/img]

[h1]New Abilities[/h1]
We've added 3 new tower abilties to Quick Tower Defence Ultimate! This is the first time we've added tower abilities to the game. Try combining the original abilities with the new ones to create devastating combinations.

The new abilities are:
[list]
[*] Brainfreeze - 20% chance on hit for enemies to reverse direction for a short time
[*] Avalanche - Attacks splash and slow in a small area
[*] Icicles - Fires 3 shots instead each for 30% damage
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42766782/cc56586a94b24dacc07c225ea811a771dc99fdb4.png[/img]

Turn Sniper towers into massive area damagers with Avalanche, Quick Towers into continual Brainfreezers, or Splash towers into hit effect specialists with Icicles

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42766782/a66d17428d399a65c6a25527d3079b43495bafdb.png[/img]

[h1]Other[/h1]
[list]
[*] Rounded several UI elements to provide a smoother look
[*] Expanded the tower upgrade panel to fit the new abilities
[/list]

notes.title: Inferno Mode!
notes.notes:
We've added Inferno mode to Quick Tower Defence Ultimate!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42766782/1640138394e5d3bb201ff675f4d334a13427f15b.png[/img]

This is a new level of difficulty for players who want more of a challenge. The differences from normal mode to Inferno mode are in the list below
[list]
[*] Three new special bosses
[list]
[*] Scorching boss - after this boss is hit, it scorches the attacking tower, increasing its cooldown by 1 second for its next shot
[*] Torrid boss - Can't be slowed, stunned or assassinated
[*] Smoldering boss - Unaffected by poison and area damage
[/list]
[*] Start each level with 5 less lives
[*] Start each level with 25 less gold
[*] Monsters have 25% more life
[*] Monsters move 5% faster
[/list]

Inferno mode is unlocked for each map individually after completing it in normal mode

notes.title: Wintertime!
notes.notes:
We've added a wonderfully jolly Wintertime Mini-Adventure to the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42766782/fd9b48355f82c569dd5a875e6bd1e70c3b6b37d0.png[/img]

Four new wintery maps have sled into Quick Tower Defence Ultimate
[list]
[*] Evergreen Terrace - Minimum Level 12
[*] Light the Trees - Minimum Level 22
[*] Candy Wrapper - Minimum Level 31
[*] Ornamental Avoidance - Minimum Level 54
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42766782/2c4c8b91a52fed73f859bd6e862d96d893ad1a3b.png[/img]

The new maps come with a chance to spawn a new enemy - Snowman!
These jolly happy souls are slightly slower and have much more health than Normal enemies and give twice as much gold. Wintertime maps are the only maps where these frosty fellows dance around

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42766782/1386d915f6fb873d1ec7a58390eaf532b881bcc3.png[/img]

Four new holiday tiles have appeared in the game. These can be used when decorating your Custom maps in the Map Editor
[list]
[*] Evergreen - Buildable
[*] Holiday Candies - Buildable
[*] Holiday Lights - Non-Buildable
[*] Holiday Ornaments - Buildable
[/list]
